column1: # CADCraft Hungarian interface catalog — original translations by the CADCraft contributors.
# License: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (the repository LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE).
# Written from CADCraft's English strings; no proprietary translations were copied.
# Clean room: every entry is written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary
# computing and technical drawing vocabulary. No other product's Hungarian interface, string table
# or terminology database was consulted, and no other catalog is used as a source.
# UTF-8: context<TAB>English source<TAB>Hungarian translation.
# Empty context = ordinary label; menu = menu bar heading; @plural = a single form with {n}:
# Hungarian uses the singular after a number, so every count reads the same (plural_forms: 1).
# Keep command IDs, keywords, technology/product names and user data unchanged.
# Conventions: the user is addressed informally (te); menu items and commands are nouns of action
# (Mentés, Réteg zárolása); only the first word of a label is capitalised. No case suffix or article
# is attached to a placeholder: the sentence puts it after a colon instead (Ismétlés: {command}).
# Quotation marks are „ ”. Command names, system variables (PICKADD, QPMODE) and command-line
# keywords stay in English, as the command line accepts them. Trailing "..." and "…" follow the
# English source exactly.
